answer: Because the orchard burn is published at the violet settlement, the onyx audit makes public the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. 69% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. The bill scales 14 fold, not the vote. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
